# Convex App Insights

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a disciplined wrapper over the official Convex MCP's read tools (`logs`, `insights`, `functionSpec`, `status`) that turns operational questions into narrow, evidence-backed queries: what's erroring, what failed after the last deploy, which functions are slow or expensive — each answer with a dashboard deep link you can one-click verify. Discipline throughout: discover identifiers before querying (no guessing function names), fetch a recent window and filter client-side (the tools have no server-side filters), three views not fifteen tools, token-frugal output. Read-only by design — it never enables prod mutation flags for an insights pass. Honest prerequisites: the `insights` tool is cloud dev/prod with user auth only, so this skill needs a Convex Cloud deployment on a paid plan; preview deployments aren't covered. Distinct from convex-cost (which uses insights to project money) and convex-launch-readiness (which consumes its findings). By @get-convex, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
